en.p: For two constants $a\ (1\le a\le 2)$ and $b$, the function $f(x)=\sin(ax+b+\sin x)$ satisfies the following conditions.

box: (B) The minimum value of the positive number $t$ with $f'(0)=f'(t)$ is $4\pi$.

en.p: Let $A$ be the set of all values $\alpha$ in the open interval $(0,\,4\pi)$ at which the function $f(x)$ has a local maximum at $x=\alpha$. If $n$ is the number of elements of set $A$ and $\alpha_1$ is the smallest element of set $A$, then $n\alpha_1-ab=\dfrac{q}{p}\pi$. Find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
